title: CIX · Silesia encoder benchmark
cutoff: Silesia-only benchmark; 12 complete official members; acquisition closed

methods.name: CIX
methods.note: Tests direct original-byte routes for the six reference methods, then eligible native CIX routes; keeps the smallest exact-verified complete archive within each profile budget.

methods.name: gzip
methods.note: Original bytes; gzip archive size is compared as a standalone reference.

methods.name: bzip2
methods.note: Original bytes; bzip2 archive size is compared as a standalone reference.

methods.name: Brotli
methods.note: Original bytes; standard Brotli format and built-in format dictionary where used.

methods.name: paq8px
methods.note: Original bytes; size maximum preset excluded before launch because estimated 29 GB working memory exceeds the 12 GB wave limit.

profiles.name: Current
profiles.note: One complete encode/decode sample per cell; times include process startup and I/O. CIX candidate selection time includes all attempted routes and failed/timeout trials. These are observed single-run timings, not repeated-run estimates.

profiles.name: Speed extreme
profiles.note: One complete encode/decode sample per cell; times include process startup and I/O. CIX candidate selection time includes all attempted routes and failed/timeout trials. These are observed single-run timings, not repeated-run estimates.

profiles.name: Size extreme
profiles.note: One complete encode/decode sample per cell; times include process startup and I/O. CIX evaluates its declared candidate set under a finite profile budget. PAQ size profile excluded at 29 GB estimated RAM.

collections.name: Silesia official corpus
collections.note: All 12 official files; publisher MD5s verified and local SHA-256s recorded.

limitations: Silesia only: no conclusions for other datasets or compression competitions.
One cold encode and one archive-only decode per row; timing rankings are provisional single observations.
PAQ -12L five-layer size preset is prelaunch resource-excluded at an estimated 29 GB RAM versus the 12 GB shared ceiling.
Per-process working-memory values are cgroup sampled high-water lower bounds, not exact peak RSS.
CIX candidates are bounded by profile budgets; a timeout is unqualified and does not prove a candidate is larger.
CIXB1 wraps selected reference streams with 47 bytes of dispatch, length and source-digest metadata; that overhead is counted.
